newsitem.title: OMAN: India's president in Oman for economic talks.
newsitem.headline: India's president in Oman for economic talks.

text.p: India's President Shankar Dayal Sharma arrived in Oman on Thursday for talks which diplomats said would focus on economic cooperation and Omani investment in the Asian country's oil and gas projects.

The Oman news agency said the Sultan of Oman, Sultan Qaboos bin Said, met Sharma at the airport. Diplomats told Reuters their talks would focus on investment protection and Omani participation in India's energy sector.

India's state-run refiner Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Ltd has said it was proceeding with a proposed joint venture refinery in partnership with Oman Oil Company. The two countries also have a fertiliser project and a gas exports project.
Oman, India and five other Indian Ocean countries are considering forming an economic bloc.
